items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: my buddy. You know, they used to preach to him on that.

ctx.x: Is he extra loud, or fast, or high, or low, or any special things about the way he played?

Well, I'll tell you about Buddy. Buddy, for you some of all kind of choppy. For you the beautifulest. I see you down on, what's this one? Is that an example? That goes to Richland? Yeah. Is that a example? Yeah. If I ever go to Richland. No, that's LaFouche. If I ever go down on LaFouche, yeah, Buddy LaFouche is there. I see you down on Buddy LaFouche, and those people were playing with the white dancers, and his brothers playing, during this time, his voice came out, my buddy. You know, they used to preach to…
He told me, you know. You didn't know him at that time? No, he had went to, he and George Washington, the family, went to California.
